disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false or fraudulent return in attempting to defeat or evade the tax
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Makes any false or fraudulent return in attempting to defeat or evade the tax imposed by this chapter is guilty of a Class 6 felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to pay tax due within sixty days from the date the tax becomes due
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to pay tax due under this chapter within sixty days from the date the tax becomes due is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep required records and books or refusing to exhibit them to the secretary of revenue
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to keep the records and books required by §10-45-45 or refuses to exhibit these records to the secretary of revenue or the secretary's agents for the purpose of examination is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to file a required return within sixty days from the date the return is due
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to file a return required by this chapter within sixty days from the date the return is due is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in business subject to the chapter without obtaining a contractor's excise tax license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in business under this chapter without obtaining a contractor's excise tax license is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in business after the contractor's excise tax license has been revoked
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in business under this chapter after the person's contractor's excise tax license has been revoked by the secretary of revenue is guilty of a Class 6 felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating failure-to-pay or failure-to-file provisions two or more times in any twelve-month period
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violates either subdivision (2) or subdivision (4) of this section two or more times in any twelve-month period is guilty of a Class 6 felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in business without a license after written notice from the secretary of revenue that licensure is required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in business under this chapter without obtaining a contractor's excise tax license after having been notified in writing by the secretary of revenue that the person is a contractor subject to the provisions of the contractors' excise tax laws is guilty of a Class 6 felony

bonding_required.quote: He may also, in his discretion, require an applicant to furnish bond to the state, or other adequate security, as security for payment of any contractor's excise tax and use tax that may become due, or require a bond or security as a condition precedent to continuing in business as a contractor.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A contractor shall post his excise tax license number assigned pursuant to this chapter with the building permit for a realty improvement project.

definition_quote.value: Prime contractors and subcontractors subject to the tax imposed by §10-46A-1 include without limitation those enumerated in the Standard Industrial Classification Manual of 1987 as prepared by the Statistical Policy Division of the Office of Management and Budget, Office of the President: construction (division c).

methods_authorized.quote: a prime contractor is a person entering into a realty improvement contract or a contract for construction services as enumerated in division c of the Standard Industrial Classification Manual
